question: I was charged twice for my subscription this month.
resolution: Apologies for the duplicate charge. We confirmed a double payment and issued a refund of the extra amount to your original payment method. It will arrive in 5 to 7 business days and you will get a confirmation email.

question: Money was deducted from my bank but the payment shows as failed.
resolution: Thanks for flagging this. When a payment fails after the bank deducts money, the amount is automatically reversed within 5 to 7 business days. If it is not back by then, reply with your transaction reference and we will trace it.

question: Why is my invoice higher than last month?
resolution: An invoice can rise when a plan renews at the standard rate or when add-ons are used. You can see the line-by-line breakdown under Billing > Invoices. If anything looks wrong, reply with the invoice number and we will review it.

question: Can you send me a GST invoice for my last payment?
resolution: Yes. Go to Billing > Invoices, choose the payment and select Download GST invoice. Make sure your GSTIN is saved under Billing details first; if it was missing, add it and we will regenerate the invoice.

question: I cancelled my plan but I was still charged.
resolution: Sorry about that. Cancellations take effect at the end of the billing cycle, so a charge made before then is valid. If you cancelled before the renewal date, send us the cancellation time and we will refund the charge.

question: My coupon code was not applied at checkout.
resolution: Coupon codes apply only to the plans and dates listed in their terms. Please check the code is valid for your plan. If it should have worked, reply with the code and we will apply the discount manually or refund the difference.

question: I want a refund for an annual plan I just bought by mistake.
resolution: Annual plans can be refunded in full within 7 days of purchase. We have started your refund and it will arrive in 5 to 7 business days. Your access will end once the refund is processed.

question: The app crashes every time I open it.
resolution: Sorry about the crashes. Please update to the latest app version, restart your device and clear the app cache. If it still crashes, reply with your device model and app version so our engineers can investigate.

question: I keep getting a login error even with the correct password.
resolution: A login error with the right password is usually caused by an expired session. Please clear your browser cookies or reinstall the app and try again. If the error code persists, send us the code and a screenshot.

question: The dashboard page is loading very slowly.
resolution: Slow loading is often caused by a large amount of data on the page. Try narrowing the date range and refreshing. If it continues after that, tell us your region and browser so we can look into it.

question: How do I change the theme or appearance settings?
resolution: Open Settings > Appearance and choose Light, Dark or System. The change applies immediately on all your devices.

question: Search is not returning any results.
resolution: Please check that filters are cleared and your spelling is correct. Search results can take a few minutes to update after new data is added. If results are still missing, share the term you searched for.

question: My exported report is empty or will not download.
resolution: Exports fail when the selected range has no data or the file is blocked by the browser. Try a different range and allow downloads for our site. If it still fails, tell us which report you were exporting.

question: My order has not arrived and it is past the delivery date.
resolution: We are sorry for the delay. We have contacted the courier and marked your order as priority. You will get an update within 24 hours. If the package is lost, we will send a replacement or refund you in full.

question: Can I change the delivery address for my order?
resolution: The address can be changed until the order is shipped. Go to My Orders, select the order and choose Edit address. If it has already shipped, contact the courier with the tracking number to redirect it.

question: Where can I track my package?
resolution: Open My Orders and select the order to see live tracking. A tracking link was also sent to your email when the order shipped. Updates can take a few hours to appear after each scan.

question: I received the wrong item in my order.
resolution: Sorry for the mix-up. Please share a photo of the item you received. We will arrange a free pickup and send the correct item, or refund you if you prefer.

question: My package arrived damaged.
resolution: We are sorry your package arrived damaged. Please send photos of the packaging and the item within 7 days. We will arrange a free replacement or a full refund.

question: The tracking status has not changed for several days.
resolution: A stalled tracking status usually means the package is waiting at a courier hub. We have raised a trace request with the courier and will update you within 48 hours.

question: Someone logged in to my account from another country.
resolution: Thank you for reporting this quickly. We have logged out all sessions and temporarily locked your account. Please reset your password from the link we sent, enable two-factor authentication and review recent activity. Reply if you see any changes you did not make.

question: I cannot reset my password, the email never arrives.
resolution: Please check your spam folder and confirm you are using the email registered on the account. Reset emails can take up to 10 minutes. If nothing arrives, we can send it to your verified backup email.

question: How do I update my phone number?
resolution: Go to Profile > Contact details, enter the new number and confirm with the one-time code we send. The change is applied immediately.

question: Please delete my account and all my data.
resolution: We can do that. Account deletion is permanent and removes your data within 30 days, apart from records we must keep for tax purposes. Please confirm using the link we are sending to your registered email.

question: I got a verification code I did not ask for.
resolution: An unrequested code can mean someone entered your email or number by mistake. Do not share the code. As a precaution, change your password and turn on two-factor authentication.

question: How do I change the email address on my account?
resolution: Open Profile > Email, enter the new address and confirm with the link we send to it. For security, the old address will get a notification.

question: Do you offer a student discount?
resolution: Yes, students get 30 percent off annual plans. Verify your student status with a valid college email or ID under Billing > Discounts, and the discount is applied at checkout.

question: Thank you, the support team was really helpful!
resolution: Thank you for the kind words. We have shared your feedback with the team. We are here whenever you need us.

question: Is there a mobile app available?
resolution: Yes, our app is available for Android and iOS. Search for our name in your app store and sign in with your existing account.

question: Can I upgrade or downgrade my plan later?
resolution: Yes. You can change your plan anytime under Billing > Plan. Upgrades apply immediately with a prorated charge, and downgrades apply from your next billing date.

question: Do you have a referral program?
resolution: Yes, invite a friend with your referral link and both of you get one month free once they subscribe.
